definitions: A colourless unstable toxic gas with a pungent odour and powerful oxidising properties, formed from oxygen by electrical discharges or ultraviolet light. It differs from normal oxygen (O2) in having three atoms in its molecule (O3).
A region of the upper atmosphere where ozone is concentrated, from about 10 to 50 km above the earth, that absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
Healthy, fresh air, especially that found at the seaside.
examples: Ozone is a powerful oxidising agent.
The ozone layer protects us from harmful UV radiation.
The fresh ozone at the coast was invigorating.
